configurations.obs: 12-D [pos, vel, goal-disp, wind]; NO obstacle geometry

configurations.apf: sensitivity grid over basis and d0 (see apf_sensitivity)

configurations.obs: 12-D base + 56-D padded RAW AABB geometry (K=8 slots, sorted by distance to UAV; per slot rel_center/300 (3), half_extents/300 (3), valid_mask (1)); total 68-D
configurations.apf: NONE (no APF force in observation, no APF blending in action)

training.hyperparameters: identical to FAIR A2C: lr 3e-4, n_steps 256, gamma 0.99, gae 0.95, ent 0.02, max_grad_norm 0.5, n_envs 1, device cpu
training.seeding: random + numpy + vecenv seed + model.set_random_seed(seed) (adds explicit torch seeding vs FAIR)

wind_sweep.definition: single interpretable rule: wind velocity vector (base + gust) multiplied by wind_scale at every step, i.e. DroneEnv3D.wind_multiplier; 1.0 reproduces FAIR setting

evaluation.heldout_note: new map seeds, same generator and density; H0 sees held-out geometry through APF, so this is controller-level transfer with map geometry available, NOT obstacle-free zero-shot generalization

apf_sensitivity.rule: report ALL 8 settings; no post-hoc selection of a favorable parameter

diagnostics: mean norms of a_A2C / a_APF / blended
action_logging.interpretation: mechanistic diagnostics only; not causal proof of smoothness

statistics.paired_tests: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on (map, training_seed) units for H0-H1 and H0-H3 and H3-H1
statistics.multiplicity: exploratory; no post-hoc family expansion for wind/held-out sweeps
statistics.wind_and_heldout: descriptive curves and per-map/per-model summaries; Wilson intervals descriptive only

dropped.H4_same_grid_spline: removed as named configuration per page-budget decision; retained only as a one-line note
dropped.fixed_lambda_causal_ablation: P2; only evaluation-time blend sensitivity if time remains, labelled as such

commands.corrected_eval: python scripts/icai2026_experiments.py eval --configs H0 H1 --maps train --seeds 101 211 307 401 503 --tag icai_eval_unique
commands.wind_sweep: python scripts/icai2026_experiments.py eval --configs H0 H1 --maps train --seeds 101 211 307 401 503 --wind-scales 0.0 0.5 1.5 2.0 --tag icai_wind_sweep
commands.heldout: python scripts/icai2026_experiments.py eval --configs H0 H1 --maps heldout --seeds 101 211 307 401 503 --tag icai_heldout
commands.action_log: python scripts/icai2026_experiments.py eval --configs H0 --maps train --seeds 101 211 307 401 503 --tag icai_action_log --log-actions
commands.h3_eval_after_training: python scripts/icai2026_experiments.py eval --configs H3 --maps train --seeds 101 211 307 401 503 --tag icai_eval_unique_h3
